roadmap.title: Prologue and Chapter 1
roadmap.description: Finish the prologue and Chapter 1, ring all three bells (after the Wandering Wight), clear the secret area and take Black Bear Guai.

roadmap.title: Chapter 2
roadmap.description: Clear the rat bosses, the Man-in-Stone and Buddha eyeball side quests, the drum and boar secret quests and the Chapter 2 final boss.

roadmap.title: Chapter 3
roadmap.description: Finish the Pagoda Realm lanterns, bosses and captain quest, then Bitter Lake, Zodiac Village, the Valley of Ecstasy side quests and Thunderclap Temple.

roadmap.title: Chapter 4
roadmap.description: Work through Webbed Hollow, the Loong chain, the talisman quest, the Purple Cloud Mountain secret area and the Chapter 4 final boss.

roadmap.title: Chapter 5
roadmap.description: Clear the cart questline, the plant bosses and the secret area, then the Chapter 5 final boss.

roadmap.title: Chapter 6 and the true ending
roadmap.description: Explore the Foothills, gather the Monkey King's gear and Skandhas, finish the final boss and clear Mount Mei.

roadmap.title: New Game+ and cleanup
roadmap.description: Start New Game+, buy the last gourd and soak, fill the last journal entries and craft the remaining armor and staffs.

achievements.description: The old monkey has told his tale. Onward you must go.
achievements.summary: Finish the prologue.

steps.text: Play through the prologue until its final cutscene ends.

achievements.description: Armed head to toe, dread not the foe.
achievements.summary: Craft any item at a shrine.

steps.text: Open the Craft menu at any @mechanic{shrine} and craft one item, such as an armor piece at the @loc{Guanyin Temple} shrine in Chapter 1.

achievements.description: Defeat Lingxuzi in Chapter 1.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Lingxuzi} in Chapter 1.

steps.text: Walk through the gate at the @loc{Guanyin Temple} and defeat @enemy{Lingxuzi}.

achievements.description: Absorb the spirit of a defeated boss with your gourd for the first time.
achievements.summary: Absorb the spirit of a defeated boss with your gourd for the first time.

steps.text: Climb the stairs to the right at @loc{Bamboo Grove: Snake Trail} and speak to the old man until his dialogue repeats. He upgrades your gourd so it can absorb spirits.
Defeat a boss that leaves a spirit, such as the frog @enemy{Baw-Li-Guhh-Lang}: from @loc{Snake Trail}, go through the building behind you, jump into the river and turn left.
Use your gourd to absorb the spirit.

achievements.description: Fresh brew in an old cask. May it stir a great task!
achievements.summary: Add a soak to your gourd's brew.

steps.text: At @loc{Marsh of White Mist}, defeat the lone snake past the shrine and talk to @npc{Shen Monkey}.
Choose Brew and add the @item{Gall Gem} soak.

achievements.description: Defeat Whiteclad Noble in Chapter 1.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Whiteclad Noble} in Chapter 1.

steps.text: Follow the main path through @loc{Marsh of White Mist} into the boss arena and defeat @enemy{Whiteclad Noble}.

achievements.description: A good match calls for a good weapon.
achievements.summary: Craft a new weapon at a shrine.

steps.text: After defeating @enemy{Whiteclad Noble}, open Craft at a shrine and craft the @item{Twin Serpents Staff}.

achievements.description: Ring the three bells of Chapter 1 to enter the hidden temple area.
achievements.summary: Ring the three bells of Chapter 1 to enter the hidden temple area.

guide.context: Defeat the @enemy{Wandering Wight} before ringing the third bell, or you lose its spirit until New Game+. Finish this area before the Chapter 1 final boss.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Guangzhi} in the arena past the bridge, left of the @loc{Outside the Forest} shrine, and ring the bell at the back.
Defeat @enemy{Guangmou} in @loc{Marsh of White Mist} and ring the bell on the left path.
Before the third bell, defeat the giant @enemy{Wandering Wight} mini boss near the bridge in @loc{Outside the Forest}.
Defeat @enemy{Whiteclad Noble}, then ring the third bell on the path left of his arena.

achievements.description: Defeat Elder Jinchi in the hidden temple area of Chapter 1.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Elder Jinchi} in the hidden temple area of Chapter 1.

guide.context: The corpse hanging from the tree by the last bell gives you the @item{Fireproof Mantle} vessel afterward.

steps.text: After ringing the third bell, enter the @loc{Ancient Guanyin Temple}, open the big doors at the back and defeat @enemy{Elder Jinchi}.

achievements.description: Defeat Black Bear Guai, the final boss of Chapter 1.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Black Bear Guai}, the final boss of Chapter 1.

steps.text: Fight through @loc{Black Wind Cave} to @loc{Bodhi Peak} and defeat @enemy{Black Bear Guai}.
Equip the @item{Fireproof Mantle} when the boss powers up halfway.

achievements.description: Tonics are well and good, but not to be wolfed like food!
achievements.summary: Make a medicine at a shrine.

steps.text: In Chapter 2, go up the steps near @loc{Sandgate Village: Village Entrance}, turn left and beat the toad boss waiting in the pit.
Talk to @npc{Xu Dog} up the stairs to learn medicine making.
At a shrine, choose Make Medicine and make one medicine.

achievements.description: Defeat the Royal Family of Flowing Sands and the First Prince of Flowing Sands in Chapter 2.
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Royal Family of Flowing Sands} and the @enemy{First Prince of Flowing Sands} in Chapter 2.

guide.context: Killing the smaller rat first enrages the larger one and lets you collect its spirit.

steps.text: Go through the doors in @loc{Sandgate Village} and defeat the duo boss. Kill the smaller rat first.
At the @loc{Valley of Despair} shrine, enter the cave, drop into the pit and defeat the @enemy{First Prince of Flowing Sands}.

achievements.description: Defeat Red Loong in the hidden waterfall of Chapter 1's forest.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Red Loong} in the hidden waterfall of Chapter 1's forest.

steps.text: In the @enemy{First Prince} arena in @loc{Valley of Despair}, break the decorative wall on the left with the Azure Dust transformation or the @item{Wandering Wight} spirit.
Open the chest behind it to get the @item{Loong Scale}.
In @loc{Forest of Wolves: Outside the Forest}, go straight and hug the left wall to the waterfall, then use the @item{Loong Scale} there.
Defeat @enemy{Red Loong}.

achievements.description: Defeat the Man-in-Stone in Chapter 2.
achievements.summary: Defeat the @npc{Man-in-Stone} in Chapter 2.

steps.text: After the @enemy{Stone Vanguard}, activate the @loc{Rockrest Flat} shrine and defeat @enemy{Mother of Stones} in the cave to the right of it.
Go to @loc{Squall Hideout}, walk around the right side and under the bridge to the @npc{Man-in-Stone} in the ravine, and defeat him.
Talk to him afterward to receive the Azure Dust transformation.

achievements.description: Defeat Black Loong in Chapter 2.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Black Loong} in Chapter 2.

steps.text: Take the @item{Loong Scale} to the sand waterfall up the stairs near the @loc{Rockrest Flat} shrine and use it to enter.
Defeat @enemy{Black Loong}.

achievements.description: Defeat the Stone Vanguard in Chapter 2.
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Stone Vanguard} in Chapter 2.

steps.text: From @loc{Rockrest Flat}, pass the statue head, turn left into the arena and defeat the @enemy{Stone Vanguard}.

achievements.description: Collect six Buddha's Eyeballs and defeat the boss they summon.
achievements.summary: Collect six Buddha's Eyeballs and defeat the boss they summon.

steps.text: Interact with the six stone Buddha heads in @loc{Fright Cliff}, around the @loc{Rockrest Flat} and @loc{Squall Hideout} shrines.
Bring them to the big rock in the @enemy{Stone Vanguard} arena, on your left as you enter from the @loc{Rockrest Flat} side, and interact with it.
Defeat @enemy{Shigandang}.

achievements.description: Finish the Old-Rattle Drum quest by defeating Mad Tiger.
achievements.summary: Finish the Old-Rattle Drum quest by defeating @enemy{Mad Tiger}.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Tiger's Acolyte} on the bridge at @loc{Yellow Wind Formation: Windrest Hamlet} to get the @item{Old-Rattle Drum}.
Play the drum when prompted near the @loc{Windrest Hamlet} shrine, beyond the big door in @loc{Valley of Despair}, and in the back-left corner of @loc{Sandgate Village: Village Entrance}.
Jump into the well at the last spot and defeat @enemy{Mad Tiger}.

achievements.description: Complete the drunk boar's quest in Chapter 2 by defeating him and entering the secret area.
achievements.summary: Complete the drunk boar's quest in Chapter 2 by defeating him and entering the secret area.

guide.context: If he asks for another item, give it: a Jade Lotus comes from water plants and an Arhat Gold Piece from the giant rat boss.

steps.text: Get a @item{Sobering Stone} from the glowing pot past @loc{Windrest Bridge} or buy one from the @npc{Man-in-Stone}.
Give it to the boar at @loc{Rockrest Flat}, then speak to him at @loc{Crouching Tiger Temple: Temple Entrance} (third right up the stairs) until his dialogue repeats.
Return to @loc{Rockrest Flat}, defeat him and go through the doors he opens.

achievements.description: Defeat all three tiger bosses in Chapter 2.
achievements.summary: Defeat all three tiger bosses in Chapter 2.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Tiger Vanguard} at the top of @loc{Crouching Tiger Temple: Temple Entrance}.
Defeat @enemy{Mad Tiger} in the well (see the Old-Rattle Drum quest).
Defeat the first boss of the @loc{Kingdom of Sahali} secret area, also called @enemy{Tiger Vanguard}.

achievements.description: Defeat Fuban in the Kingdom of Sahali secret area.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Fuban} in the @loc{Kingdom of Sahali} secret area.

guide.context: This also gives the @item{Wind Tamer} vessel.

steps.text: Enter the secret area through the boar quest and activate the @loc{Sandgate Bound} shrine.
Talk to the NPC standing at the cliff edge behind the shrine, then go down and defeat @enemy{Fuban}.

achievements.description: Receive medicine pills from Xu Dog at the Cellar.
achievements.summary: Receive medicine pills from @npc{Xu Dog} at the Cellar.

steps.text: After the @enemy{Stone Vanguard}, climb to the top of @loc{Crouching Tiger Temple}, interact with the statue, go through and slide down to the @loc{Cellar} shrine.
Turn right to find @npc{Xu Dog}. Talk to him twice, picking the Talk option the second time.

achievements.description: Defeat Yellow Wind Sage, the final boss of Chapter 2.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Yellow Wind Sage}, the final boss of Chapter 2.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Wind Tamer} vessel and go through the big doors at @loc{Windseal Gate}.
Defeat @enemy{Yellow Wind Sage}, using the vessel to clear the sandstorms.

achievements.description: Complete the two-headed rat quest to receive the Ashen Slumber spell.
achievements.summary: Complete the two-headed rat quest to receive the Ashen Slumber spell.

guide.context: If the corpse is not there, the spell comes from a boss at the very end of the floor above.

steps.text: In Chapter 2, speak to the voices in the shack up the hill from @loc{Sandgate Village: Village Entrance} until the dialogue repeats.
In Chapter 3's @loc{Pagoda Realm}, defeat @enemy{Captain Lotus-Vision} at the @loc{Upper Pagoda} to get the cell key.
Open the cell next to your starting cell and pull the sword from the corpse.

achievements.description: Defeat Captain Wise-Voice, the boss crowning the Pagoda Realm.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Captain Wise-Voice}, the boss crowning the Pagoda Realm.

guide.context: Kill the nine lantern-headed enemies of this area before the boss if you also want the @item{Auspicious Lantern} curio.

steps.text: Cross the bridge at @loc{Mani Wheel} and defeat @enemy{Captain Wise-Voice}.

achievements.description: Defeat Kang-Jin Star in Chapter 3.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Kang-Jin Star} in Chapter 3.

steps.text: Follow the main path past the @loc{Warding Temple} and through the sliding section to the boss.
Defeat @enemy{Kang-Jin Star}. If you die, you restart near the @loc{Turtle Island} shrine.

achievements.description: Defeat Cyan Loong on Turtle Island.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Cyan Loong} on Turtle Island.

steps.text: Take the @item{Loong Scale} to the south-east of @loc{Turtle Island} and use it on the statue right of the shrine.
Defeat @enemy{Cyan Loong}.

achievements.description: Defeat the boss at the giant snake bones and collect the Turtle Tear.
achievements.summary: Defeat the boss at the giant snake bones and collect the Turtle Tear.

guide.context: The boss does not appear after this chapter.

steps.text: At @loc{Bitter Lake: North Shore}, follow the shore to the right to the giant snake bones and defeat the boss at the skull.
Return to where the turtle dropped you and pick up the green @item{Turtle Tear}.

achievements.description: Deliver Xu Dog's medicine to Chen Loong to reach Zodiac Village.
achievements.summary: Deliver Xu Dog's medicine to Chen Loong to reach Zodiac Village.

steps.text: At @loc{Bitter Lake: North Shore}, defeat the mini boss in the water and talk to @npc{Chen Loong}.
Speak to @npc{Xu Dog} at @loc{Crouching Tiger Temple: Cellar} to get the item he needs.
Bring it back to @npc{Chen Loong} and activate the @loc{Zodiac Village} shrine.

achievements.description: Upgrade an armor piece at the Zodiac Village blacksmith.
achievements.summary: Upgrade an armor piece at the Zodiac Village blacksmith.

steps.text: Talk to the blacksmith at @loc{Zodiac Village: Village Entrance} and upgrade any armor piece once.

achievements.description: Defeat the Zodiac Village blacksmith in a challenge fight.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Zodiac Village blacksmith in a challenge fight.

guide.context: The fight is hard, so it is better to return once you have better gear.

steps.text: Talk to the blacksmith, choose Challenge and defeat @enemy{Yin Tiger}. He survives the fight.

achievements.description: Harvest planted seeds from Chen Loong's field for the first time.
achievements.summary: Harvest planted seeds from Chen Loong's field for the first time.

steps.text: Give seeds to @npc{Chen Loong} with Deliver Seeds at @loc{Zodiac Village}.
Wait for the plants to grow, then choose Harvest.

achievements.description: Complete the treasure hunter's quest and receive the Spell Binder spell.
achievements.summary: Complete the treasure hunter's quest and receive the Spell Binder spell.

steps.text: At @loc{Bitter Lake: North Shore}, defeat the bats attacking the NPC and speak to him.
At @loc{Valley of Ecstasy: Towers of Karma}, cast Ring of Fire on the frozen treasure hunter and keep talking to him until he starts repeating himself.
Go to the @loc{Watermelon Field} shrine, enter the cave and defeat the boss.

achievements.description: Defeat Non-Void in fox form and return to the fox corpse.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Non-Void} in fox form and return to the fox corpse.

steps.text: At @loc{Valley of Ecstasy: Forest of Felicity}, examine the corpse beside the gate to turn into a fox.
In @loc{New Thunderclap Temple}, defeat @enemy{Non-Void} while in fox form.
Go back to the same corpse beside the gate in @loc{Forest of Felicity}.

achievements.description: Return the spirits of the four captains to the prisoner next to your cell in the Pagoda Realm.
achievements.summary: Return the spirits of the four captains to the prisoner next to your cell in the Pagoda Realm.

steps.text: Collect the spirits of @enemy{Captain Lotus-Vision}, @enemy{Captain Wise-Voice}, @enemy{Captain Void-Illusion} (a giant root corpse northwest of @loc{Longevity Road}) and @enemy{Captain Kalpa-Wave} (at @loc{Thunderclap Temple}).
Return to @loc{Pagoda Realm: Lower Pagoda} and give them to the prisoner housed beside your starting cell.

achievements.description: Defeat the four disciples: Non-White, Non-Able, Non-Pure and Non-Void.
achievements.summary: Defeat the four disciples: @enemy{Non-White}, @enemy{Non-Able}, @enemy{Non-Pure} and @enemy{Non-Void}.

steps.text: @enemy{Non-White} is a story boss in @loc{Valley of Ecstasy}.
Find @enemy{Non-Able} kneeling in an arena on the main path near @loc{Brook of Bliss}.
Find @enemy{Non-Pure} in the temple left of the @loc{Mahavira Hall} shrine.
Fight @enemy{Non-Void} in fox form at @loc{New Thunderclap Temple: Temple Entrance}.

achievements.description: Defeat the Macaque Chief at the end of Chapter 3.
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Macaque Chief} at the end of Chapter 3.

steps.text: Follow the story to @loc{New Thunderclap Temple} and defeat the @enemy{Macaque Chief} on the third encounter.

achievements.description: Defeat Yellowbrow, the final boss of Chapter 3.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Yellowbrow}, the final boss of Chapter 3.

steps.text: Continue the story past the @enemy{Macaque Chief} and defeat @enemy{Yellowbrow}.

achievements.description: Defeat Buddha's Right Hand in Chapter 4.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Buddha's Right Hand} in Chapter 4.

steps.text: Activate the @loc{Cliff of Oblivion} shrine in @loc{Webbed Hollow}, take the path ahead and beat the boss.

achievements.description: Defeat Zhu Bajie in Chapter 4.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Zhu Bajie} in Chapter 4.

steps.text: Reach the @loc{Hut of Immortality} shrine in @loc{Webbed Hollow}, go up the new path through the crack and defeat @enemy{Zhu Bajie} in the arena.

achievements.description: Defeat Violet Spider in Chapter 4.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Violet Spider} in Chapter 4.

steps.text: Activate the @loc{Gathering Cave} shrine and defeat @enemy{Violet Spider}, then run through the scripted escape.

achievements.description: Defeat Yellow Loong in Chapter 4.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Yellow Loong} in Chapter 4.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Red Loong}, @enemy{Black Loong} and @enemy{Cyan Loong} first.
In @loc{Webbed Hollow: Cliff of Oblivion}, drop left of the bridge, cross the rope bridge and use Cloud Step over the beam to reach @loc{Relief of the Fallen Loong}.
With the @item{Loong Scale}, climb the stone stairway on the shrine's right side and defeat @enemy{Yellow Loong}.

achievements.description: Enter the Chapter 4 secret area by defeating the Venom Daoist a second time.
achievements.summary: Enter the Chapter 4 secret area by defeating the @enemy{Venom Daoist} a second time.

guide.context: Finish this secret area before the Chapter 4 final boss.

steps.text: At @loc{Webbed Hollow: Pool of Shattered Jade}, go up the path, break the old cocoon and fight the @enemy{Venom Daoist}. Break four of his six back arms before he dies if you want the @item{Venomous Armguard}.
Head to the @loc{Court of Illumination} in the @loc{Temple of Yellow Flowers}, descend the stairs, pass through the building, take the left fork and defeat him again.

achievements.description: Bring Daoist Mi a Violet Hail in the Chapter 4 secret area.
achievements.summary: Bring Daoist Mi a Violet Hail in the Chapter 4 secret area.

guide.context: Do this before defeating @enemy{The Duskveil}.

steps.text: In @loc{Purple Cloud Mountain: Petalfall Hamlet}, talk to @npc{Daoist Mi}.
Defeat the yellow-clad enemies in the village until one drops a Violet Hail and bring it to him.

achievements.description: Defeat the five scorpions of Chapter 4.
achievements.summary: Defeat the five scorpions of Chapter 4.

guide.context: Defeat @enemy{The Scorpionlord} before @enemy{The Duskveil}.

steps.text: Defeat the scorpion on the slope left of the @loc{Pool of Shattered Jade} shrine.
Defeat the scorpion spirit in the village at @loc{The Verdure Bridge}.
Defeat the scorpion on the rise at the back of the @loc{Relief of the Fallen Loong} shrine.
Defeat the scorpion past the cavern stairs at @loc{The Purifying Spring}.
In the secret area, break the pot below the scorpion at @loc{Bounds of Deity's Abode} to start the fight with @enemy{The Scorpionlord}.

achievements.description: Defeat The Duskveil in the Chapter 4 secret area.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{The Duskveil} in the Chapter 4 secret area.

guide.context: This gives the @item{Weaver's Needle} vessel for the final boss's second half.

steps.text: Finish the quests with @npc{Daoist Mi} and the scorpions first.
Go to @loc{Cloudnest Peak} and defeat @enemy{The Duskveil}.

achievements.description: Remove all four talismans in Chapter 4.
achievements.summary: Remove all four talismans in Chapter 4.

guide.context: The fourth talisman must come last because a boss appears there.

steps.text: Pull the talisman at the tower on @loc{The Verdure Bridge} after the cutscene.
Pull the talisman right of the @loc{Cliff of Oblivion} shrine.
Climb the hill behind the @loc{Relief of the Fallen Loong} shrine, keep left and pull the talisman.
In the @loc{Court of Illumination} of the @loc{Temple of Yellow Flowers}, climb the stairs and pull the last talisman, then fight the boss that appears down to 80% health.

achievements.description: Defeat the Hundred-Eyed Daoist Master, the final boss of Chapter 4.
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Hundred-Eyed Daoist Master}, the final boss of Chapter 4.

steps.text: Advance the story and defeat the @enemy{Hundred-Eyed Daoist Master}. Use the @item{Weaver's Needle} vessel in the second half.

achievements.description: Max out your starting gourd and talk to the old man in each of the five chapters.
achievements.summary: Max out your starting gourd and talk to the old man in each of the five chapters.

steps.text: Keep upgrading the starting @item{Old Gourd} until it reaches maximum level.

Keep talking to the old man until he loops his lines at @loc{Bamboo Grove: Snake Trail}, @loc{Crouching Tiger Temple: Cellar}, @loc{Pagoda Realm: Warding Temple} (reached after the @enemy{Macaque Chief} fight), @loc{Temple of Yellow Flowers: Temple Entrance} and @loc{Furnace Valley: Rakshasa Palace}.
In @loc{Rakshasa Palace}, touch the flame in the center of the room to finish the upgrade.

achievements.description: Defeat the Keeper of the Flaming Mountains in Chapter 5.
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Keeper of the Flaming Mountains} in Chapter 5.

steps.text: Climb to @loc{The Emerald Hall} and defeat the @enemy{Keeper of the Flaming Mountains}.

achievements.description: Finish the horse NPC Ma Tianba's questline across Chapters 1 to 5.
achievements.summary: Finish the horse NPC Ma Tianba's questline across Chapters 1 to 5.

guide.context: He can no longer be completed after the @enemy{Yin-Yang Fish} fight unless you spoke to him earlier.

steps.text: Talk to him until he repeats himself in @loc{Bamboo Grove: Back Hills}, @loc{Sandgate Village: Village Entrance}, on the bridge in @loc{New Thunderclap Temple} and in the cocoon in @loc{Webbed Hollow: Middle Hollow}.
In Chapter 5, speak to the cart in the lava at @loc{Furnace Valley: Valley Entrance}.
After the @enemy{Yin-Yang Fish} fight, return there and pull the string to get the Dark Thunder transformation.

achievements.description: Take more as fruit as your plants take root.
achievements.summary: Collect one of each of the 15 seed types.

guide.context: Seeds are random drops. Plants regrow after a while, and setting your PC clock forward one hour respawns them.

steps.text: Pick plants and defeat plant enemies throughout the game and collect these seeds: Jade Lotus, Nine-Capped Lingzi, Monkey-Head Fungus, Fragrant Jade Flower, Fire Bellflower, Tree Pearl, Celestial Pear, Licorice, Fire Date, Millennium Ginseng, Gentian and Golden Lotus.
Give the Nine-Capped Lingzi, Monkey-Head Fungus and Millennium Ginseng seeds to @npc{Chen Loong} to receive Purple Lingzi, Snake-Head Mushroom and Aged Ginseng.

achievements.description: Defeat the six plant bosses of the game.
achievements.summary: Defeat the six plant bosses of the game.

guide.context: If the achievement does not unlock, also defeat @enemy{Minor Amourworm}, @enemy{Fungiling}, @enemy{Ginsengling} and @enemy{Lingzhiling}.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Fungiman} (mushrooms in a cell at @loc{Upper Pagoda}), @enemy{Old Ginseng Guai} (plants at @loc{Towers of Karma}) and @enemy{Elder Amourworm} (behind the chests at @loc{The Verdure Bridge}).

Defeat @enemy{Fungiwoman} (mushrooms at @loc{Court of Illumination}), @enemy{Nine-Capped Lingzhi Guai} (mushroom right of the @loc{Ashen Pass III} shrine) and @enemy{Mother of Flamlings} (feed four Flame Ore to the lava pool past @enemy{Flint Vanguard}).

achievements.description: Finish the minotaur's quest and enter the secret area of Chapter 5.
achievements.summary: Finish the minotaur's quest and enter the secret area of Chapter 5.

guide.context: Do these steps in order and finish before the Chapter 5 final boss.

steps.text: Defeat the minotaur @npc{Pale-Axe Stalwart} in @loc{Woods of Ember: Ashen Pass}, then talk to him repeatedly until his lines loop.
Defeat the first and second carts, talk to the inactive third cart, then talk to the Stalwart again.
Defeat the fourth cart and talk to the Stalwart, then defeat the last cart at @loc{The Cooling Slope}.
Talk to the Stalwart once more, walk through the ice wall and activate the tower in the cave below.

achievements.description: The most marvelous places for meditation have all met your gaze.
achievements.summary: Use every meditation spot in the game.

steps.text: Use all 24 meditation pillows: 3 in Chapter 1, 6 in Chapter 2, 5 in Chapter 3, 6 in Chapter 4 and 4 in Chapter 5. The last one is at @loc{Bishui Cave: Purge Pit}, right of the shrine.

achievements.description: Defeat all three duo boss fights in Chapter 5.
achievements.summary: Defeat all three duo boss fights in Chapter 5.

steps.text: Defeat the two duo bosses on the main route in Chapter 5.
Defeat the duo boss at @loc{Bishui Cave: Purge Pit} in the secret area.

achievements.description: Collect every spirit in the game.
achievements.summary: Collect every spirit in the game.

guide.context: Spirits you did not pick up can be collected at shrines.

steps.text: Defeat bosses and spirit enemies throughout the game and absorb each spirit they drop.
Before the third bell in Chapter 1, defeat the @enemy{Wandering Wight}. In the Chapter 2 rat duo fight, kill the smaller rat first.

achievements.description: Defeat the last boss of the secret area in Chapter 5.
achievements.summary: Defeat the last boss of the secret area in Chapter 5.

steps.text: Go to the @loc{Corridor of Fire and Ice} shrine in @loc{Bishui Cave} and defeat the @enemy{Bishui Golden-Eyed Beast}. The @item{Fireproof Mantle} vessel helps.

achievements.description: Defeat Red Boy, the final boss of Chapter 5.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Red Boy}, the final boss of Chapter 5.

steps.text: Go to @loc{Fallen Furnace Crater} and defeat @enemy{Red Boy}.

achievements.description: Obtain all four vessels.
achievements.summary: Obtain all four vessels.

guide.context: Clear the Chapter 5 secret area first, then the Chapter 5 final boss, so the @item{Plantain Fan} is certain to be awarded.

steps.text: Get the @item{Fireproof Mantle} from the Chapter 1 secret area, the @item{Wind Tamer} from the Chapter 2 secret area, the @item{Weaver's Needle} from the Chapter 4 secret area and the @item{Plantain Fan} from the Chapter 5 secret area or end of Chapter 5.

achievements.description: Reach Mount Mei through the Great Pagoda.
achievements.summary: Reach Mount Mei through the Great Pagoda.

steps.text: Complete the four secret areas (Chapters 1, 2, 4 and 5) and finish the main story once, then choose Continue Journey.
Go to @loc{The Great Pagoda} shrine in @loc{Pagoda Realm: Snow-Veiled Trail}, walk up the steps and speak to the child.
Reach the @loc{Mei-Jian Peak} shrine.

achievements.description: Beat every boss fight on Mount Mei.
achievements.summary: Beat every boss fight on Mount Mei.

guide.context: This also unlocks the secret ending.

steps.text: Defeat the three bosses in a row; there is a checkpoint between each. The @item{Plantain Fan} helps break the first boss's shield.

achievements.description: Each guise grants a new horizon.
achievements.summary: Obtain all ten transformations.

steps.text: Collect: Red Tides (@enemy{Guangzhi}), Azure Dust (@npc{Man-in-Stone}), Ebon Flow (@enemy{Yin Tiger}), Ashen Slumber (two-headed rat quest) and Hoarfrost (@enemy{Monk from the Sea}).
Collect: Umbral Abyss (story), Violet Hail (@npc{Daoist Mi}), Golden Lining (@enemy{Yellow Loong}), Dark Thunder (Ma Tianba) and Azure Dome (Mount Mei).

achievements.description: Now you can sate yourself with all the drinks.
achievements.summary: Obtain all nine brews.

steps.text: Collect Coconut Wine, Loong Balm, Bluebridge Romance, Worryfree Brew, Jade Essence, Sunset of the Nine Skies and Lambbrew from the world.
Buy A Thousand Days Inebriation and Pinebrew from @npc{Shen Monkey}.

achievements.description: Unlock the Somersault Cloud in Chapter 6.
achievements.summary: Unlock the Somersault Cloud in Chapter 6.

steps.text: Start Chapter 6, activate the @loc{Verdant Path} shrine and defeat the boss ahead.

achievements.description: Defeat one frog boss in each of the six chapters.
achievements.summary: Defeat one frog boss in each of the six chapters.

steps.text: Defeat these frogs: @enemy{Baw-Li-Guhh-Lang} (Snake Trail), @enemy{Lang-Li-Guhh-Baw} (Sandgate pit), @enemy{Lang-Li-Guhh-Lang} (hidden path at @loc{Forest of Felicity}), @enemy{Baw-Li-Guhh-Baw} (crack in @loc{Lower Hollow}), @enemy{Baw-Lang-lang} (@loc{The Cooling Slope}) and @enemy{Lang-Baw-Baw} (mud below the rhino battlefield in @loc{Deer Sight Forest}).

achievements.description: Every rare wonder the world can offer, collected and kept.
achievements.summary: Collect every curio in the game.

guide.context: The @item{Auspicious Lantern} is missable. The last curio, @item{Celestial Birthstone Fragment}, drops from @enemy{Lang-Baw-Baw}.

steps.text: Collect all 36 curios, excluding the Deluxe Edition Wind Chime.
Defeat all nine lantern-headed enemies in the Pagoda Realm before @enemy{Captain Wise-Voice}.
Farm the rare drops with enemy drop-rate gear and the @item{Golden Carp} curio.

achievements.description: Give all five Skandhas to Xu Dog.
achievements.summary: Give all five Skandhas to Xu Dog.

steps.text: Collect the Skandha of Form (statue in the river at @loc{Front Hill}), Feeling (the Buddha's Eyeball boss), Thought (@loc{Mindfulness Cliff}), Choice (@loc{The Purifying Spring}) and Consciousness (@enemy{Giant Shigandang}).
Hand all five to @npc{Xu Dog}, found in the @loc{Cellar} of @loc{Crouching Tiger Temple} or in @loc{Zodiac Village}.

achievements.description: "Here, have it, have it all."
achievements.summary: Collect five health, five mana and five stamina upgrades and the Five Skandhas Pill.

guide.context: Extra upgrades convert to Will, and upgrades from earlier playthroughs still count in New Game+.

steps.text: Collect five of each Celestial pill (health, mana, stamina) from chests and meditation spots.
Give the five Skandhas to @npc{Xu Dog} for the Five Skandhas Pill.

achievements.description: Defeat all the Foothills bosses in Chapter 6.
achievements.summary: Defeat all the Foothills bosses in Chapter 6.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Son of Stones}, four @enemy{Poison Chiefs}, @enemy{Water-Wood Beast}, @enemy{Jiao-Loong of Waves} and @enemy{Lang-Baw-Baw} in the @loc{Foothills}.
With all five Skandhas, enter the cave on the cliff right of the vertical tree at @loc{Mantis-Catching Swamp}, defeat @enemy{Giant Shigandang} and climb its arm.

achievements.description: Collect the Monkey King's armor set and the Jingubang staff.
achievements.summary: Collect the Monkey King's armor set and the Jingubang staff.

steps.text: Defeat the four armor bosses in the @loc{Foothills}: the grasshopper, the rhino, the deer and the mantis.
Follow the waterfall path up from @loc{Mantis-Catching Swamp} to the @loc{Water Curtain Cave} and interact with the staff.

achievements.description: Defeat the final boss of Chapter 6.
achievements.summary: Defeat the final boss of Chapter 6.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Peak of Innocence} and defeat both bosses. There is a checkpoint between them.

achievements.description: Humans, beasts, yaoguais, and the Bodhisattvas. All recorded and noted.
achievements.summary: Fill every journal entry.

guide.context: Portraits depend on optional quests, such as bringing Zhu Bajie to @enemy{Apramāṇa Bat} in Chapter 3.

steps.text: Fill the journal with 90 Lesser Yaoguai entries, 26 Kings, 55 Chiefs and 32 Characters.
Start New Game+ to receive @npc{The Great Sage's Broken Shell} and then @npc{Yuan Shoucheng}.

achievements.description: Get the true ending and all six relics.
achievements.summary: Get the true ending and all six relics.

steps.text: Finish the true ending, then start New Game+ with Enter a New Cycle.

achievements.description: All spells we know are derived from the same source.
achievements.summary: Obtain every spell.

steps.text: Get Immobilize, Ring of Fire, Spell Binder, Cloud Step, Rock Solid and A Pluck of Many during the story. Spell Binder comes from the treasure hunter quest.
Start New Game+ to receive Life-Saving Strand.

achievements.description: Rare is not the gourd but a friend to drink with.
achievements.summary: Obtain all 11 gourds.

guide.context: The Stained Jade Gourd is missable: defeat @enemy{The Scorpionlord} before @enemy{The Duskveil}.

steps.text: Collect the Old, Supreme, Multi-Glazed, Immortal Blessing, Xiang River Goddess, Jade Lotus, Stained Jade, Fiery, Plaguebane and Trailblazer's Scarlet gourds.
In New Game+, buy the Qing-Tian Gourd from @npc{Shen Monkey}.

achievements.description: "All the tattered pages can now be compiled in full."
achievements.summary: Obtain all 14 formulas.

steps.text: Buy the formulas @npc{Xu Dog} sells and find the chest formulas in the world.
In New Game+, buy the Soul Remigration Pill from @npc{Xu Dog}.

achievements.description: A blend for every brew to bring out its best.
achievements.summary: Obtain all 27 soaks.

steps.text: Collect soaks from chests, shops and plant drops, from Flower Primes through Flame Mediator.
In New Game+, buy Guanyin's Willow Leaf from @npc{Shen Monkey}.

achievements.description: Shoes on feet, hat on head, embroidered shirt, Daoist robe—free as can be, doing as you please!
achievements.summary: Collect every armor piece.

steps.text: Craft or loot all 18 helms, 19 chests, 20 gloves and 17 legs, including both the Old Monkey and Monkey King sets.
Break four of the @enemy{Venom Daoist}'s six back arms for the @item{Venomous Armguard}.
Collect the @item{Bull King's Iron Horn} from the Chapter 5 secret area.

achievements.description: A walking vault of arms you have become!
achievements.summary: Craft and fully upgrade every weapon.

steps.text: Craft every staff, including those unlocked in New Game+.
Gather rare materials: Sky Piercing Horn, Kun Steel, four Loong Pearls, four Bull King's Iron Horns and Samadhi Fire Crystals.
Fully upgrade every staff.

achievements.description: Each ordeal paves your path to what you are meant to be.
achievements.summary: Earn every other achievement and use every upgrade type once.

steps.text: Earn all other achievements.
If this one does not unlock, upgrade an armor piece, upgrade a weapon and use a medicine item.
